evidence: The pulse sequence was optimized to prevent disastrous particulate problems while still minimizing purge times. The resulting films are then characterized. Optical reflectometry and ellipsometry (J. A. Woollam Co., Inc., Model M-44 ) were used for film thickness. Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (Nicolet, Magna-IR 560) and energy dispersive x-ray fluorescence (Amray Model 1600 ) were used for film composition information. Scanning transmission electron microscopy / electron energy loss spectroscopy (STEM/EELS) and TEM (JEOL 2010F) were used for film structure. Details of the STEM/EELS used are reported elsewhere. 16,17
